snippet.title: Astronaut: The Best - Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
Astronaut: The Best is out now for PC and Steam Deck! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239950/Astronaut_The_Best/

To celebrate our first major content update and sale, here's a trailer sharing how outwardly reputable games media outlets have judged Astronaut: The Best. 

Astronaut: The Best is an occult management adventure about running a space academy using lies, witchcraft, and/or hard work. Your astronauts aren't just stats: they're incompetent screwups. You must guide these procedurally misfit recruits through a roguelite web of scandals, challenges, and space-shatteringly meaningful choices. Turn them into national heroes by any means necessary, or your bosses will see you dead in a ditch.
